none: PAS SOM-F407C5: Roman coin: double struck nummus, possiblyof Valentinian II
contea di ritrovamento: Wiltshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy nummus, probably of Valentinian II (AD 375-392), dating to AD 378-383 (Reece period 21). Probably VOT V MVLT X reverse type, depicting an inscribed wreath. Uncertain mint, possibly Arles. The coin has been double struck, with the second striking at 9 o'clock to the first
